reports.title: 1.Net earnings represent net earnings attributable to the shareholders of the Company.

lines: YTD 2026 Owner Mining AISC of $1,729, is at the low-end of the full-year guidance range of $1,700 to $1,800 per ounce.

◦CMP-sourced gold comprised 33% of the mill feed and generated an AISC sales margin of 37%, bringing YTD 2026 CMP AISC sales margin to 41%, above the top-end of the full-year 2026 guidance range of 35% to 40%.
